softwarePortfolioLayout.aboutApplication:
The 1-3-5 application enables users to plan and prioritize their daily tasks effectively, with company-wide visibility allowing managers to assign and monitor progress. Users manage their daily workload by adding tasks, marking completions, and rescheduling incomplete items across the calendar, with a waiting list capturing all pending activities.


The system provides a robust timer feature to record time-spent on each task, functioning essentially as a digital timesheet. By centralizing task tracking and priority management, the application boosts individual productivity while providing management with the data needed to oversee daily operations and resource allocation.
softwarePortfolioLayout.clientName: An IT system integrator with a workforce of over 200 engineers based in Mumbai.
softwarePortfolioLayout.testimonialContent: The 1-3-5 application has become essential for our workforce. It provides us with the company-wide visibility we need to monitor tasks and ensures our engineers are focused on their highest priorities every day.
